text:
devops-ci: Deploy blocked for rc/5 -> preprod. License + vuln gate failed, stopping rollout.

devops-ci: SBOM check found a GPL-3.0 transitive dep 'old-ssl' pulled in by service-auth.

devops-ci: Snyk scan: 2 HIGH vulns detected in libcrypto-x@2.3.4 (CVE-2025-XXXX). Snippet:
```
libcrypto-x@2.3.4 - HIGH - Arbitrary code execution
Path: service-auth > auth-core > libcrypto-x@2.3.4
```

matt: which artifacts are affected? can we pin to libcrypto-x@2.3.5 and re-run?

sara: we tried 2.3.5 on integration and hit linking failures on musl images, so not safe to pin blindly.

julia-legal: GPL-3.0 transitive dependency needs review. What's the usage surface and distribution plan? we can't ship customer-facing binaries without a legal decision.

matt: looks like old-ssl is only used by legacy TLS fallback in auth-core. We can remove the fallback with a small refactor, ETA ~4 hours.

ops-oncall: can we pause and keep the current canary in place instead of automatic rollback?

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback for rc/5 scheduled in 15m unless a hold is set.

ops-oncall: I'll pause rollout manually. Hold set. Canary remains at 2/8 nodes.

julia-legal: please attach the SBOM and link the code path so legal can triage. I'll aim to respond by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sara: SBOM uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/sbom/rc-5.json (service-auth section highlighted).

security: short-term mitigation suggestion: disable legacy TLS fallback in preprod canary via env `REDWOOD_TLS_LEGACY=false` and re-run vuln checks.

matt: applying env change to preprod canary now...

matt: env applied, re-running vulnerability scan.

devops-ci: Vulnerability scan results: 0 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM (libcrypto-x still present in build metadata but not in runtime path).

julia-legal: Legal holds approval until we either remove the dependency or obtain re-licensing. Holding approval for public rollout. :no_entry:

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Pausing release window and notifying release-owner. No rollback executed.

release-owner: Acknowledged. Postponing RC5 public rollout. Will update changelog and ship notes + notify customers on the scheduled list.

sara: Opening follow-up PR to remove the dependency: https://git.company/repos/service-auth/pulls/482 (includes small refactor + test fix).

matt: if PR merges today we can run a full regression and attempt to resume rollout during tomorrow's change window.

release-owner: Marking thread as SEC-HOLD and adding to release board (release/rc5).

devops-ci: Final status: BLOCKED by legal + security. Action items: (1) Merge dependency-removal PR or relicense; (2) legal sign-off; (3) green vuln scan. Will reopen rollout when all gates pass.

ops-oncall: Thanks everyone, keeping this pinned until cleared.
